segments.title: Requesting Annual Heritage Data Chart
description: Committee members feel they lack data when assessing delegations or projects.
Proposal to request an annual basic chart of heritage data from administration.
Data would include grants awarded and money invested in heritage properties.
This would help monitor the heritage strategy and inform discussions.

segments.title: Confirming Work Plan Focus Areas
description: Committee agrees to focus on three main items for the year.

chips.text: Committee confirms focus on Heritage Policy/Plan, Heritage Awards, and Intangible Heritage.
